tissue_review_notes: Remains protected. Regional removal does not justify whole-system depletion or injury to lymphatic stroma. Lineage-specific exceptions require a separately defined policy and evidence.

Conditional organ allowance only. Identify the expressing cell population and its distribution in blood, marrow and other organs. Assess age and immune reserve. Surgery is not a model of systemic antigen-directed injury. Bulk tissue cannot establish organ confinement. Assess consequences of functional asplenia and an appropriate infection-prevention and management strategy before therapeutic acceptance.
